en.hubeali: H 14803 – Yahya Al-halby, from Al-Musna, from Abu Baseer, who has said: Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Statement of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic: “[10:27] as if their faces had been covered with slices of the dense darkness of night”, heasws said: ‘But, have you seen the house when it is the night, so it would be darker inside than the outside of it. So, like that, their darkness would be increased’.
en.sarwar: 356. Yahya Al-halby, from Al-Musna, from Abu Baseer, who has said: Abu Abdullah (a.s.)
regarding the Statement of Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic:
“[10:27] as if their faces had been covered with slices of the dense darkness of night”,
he (a.s.) said: ‘But, have you seen the house when it is the night, so it would be darker inside than the outside of it. So, like that, their darkness would be increased’.
